human_direction: Do not freeze the experience into predefined thematic axes. Prefer an interactive discovery model that leaves room for visitor creativity, free-form intent and system suggestions, including reuse or connection of already-generated guides when relevant.

experiment.entry: Ask the visitor what they feel like discovering, understanding or following, in their own words.
experiment.suggestion_behavior: Offer up to three contextual suggestions derived from the current place, route and available qualified content. Suggestions are examples, never categories the visitor must adopt.
experiment.freedom: The visitor may ignore suggestions, combine them, reformulate the request, change direction later, or ask an entirely new question.
experiment.reuse: Prefer compatible already-qualified episodes, extras or cross-city material when they answer the request; identify when new generation would be required.
experiment.generation: Any newly generated material must pass the normal research, factual, artistic and audio-production gates before becoming a qualified reusable guide asset.
experiment.depth: The visitor can ask for a quick explanation, more detail, anecdotes, another perspective or a deeper thread without choosing a persistent profile.
experiment.sound: Immersive sound remains optional and must be artistically justified, never inferred automatically from a topic suggestion.
